title: Just Juice Black Mint 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Just Juice Mint Range Black Mint Shortfill delivers a triple-layer menthol experience for fans of icy-cool flavours. This bold blend features three distinct layers of menthol that combine to create an intensely refreshing vape, perfect for those who love an extra-cold, bracing menthol hit with every puff. The Just Juice Mint Range shortfills come in a 120ml bottle, containing 100ml of 0mg nicotine e-liquid. There’s space for up to two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your nicotine strength. Adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nicotine shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. With its 70VG/30PG blend, this e-liquid is best suited for sub-ohm vape kits and high-powered devices, delivering thick, satisfying vapour and intense flavour. Just Juice has a reputation for crafting premium e-liquids in a wide range of delicious flavour profiles. Their Mint Range offers a selection of cooling menthol e-liquids, perfect for vapers who enjoy crisp, fresh menthol vapes.
